Subject: VAT treatment for nonresident vendor / PO setup

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — NileSoft is excited to move to a POC. Before we enable the first test PO I need your procurement/tax guidance: our finance team in Cairo asked whether Redwood will charge Egyptian VAT on invoices from our local branch or whether the customer (NileSoft) should self-account under the reverse-charge rule.

A few specific asks so we can complete our vendor onboarding form: 
- Is Redwood planning to register for VAT in Egypt or will you supply invoices without VAT for nonresident suppliers?
- If we are expected to self-account, what invoice fields do you require so our accountant can map to your PO (VAT indicator, tax point, supplier VAT number)?
- Do you need our Egyptian VAT certificate and the company registration (commercial register)?

We prefer the PO to show the charge in EGP and a separate line for tax treatment (VAT reverse-charge: customer accounted) so it flows into our local tax system. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred PO/tax mapping and any required attachments?

I can attach our VAT certificate and a sample proforma — I will send those if you confirm the right contact and fields.

Thanks,
Mohamed
Procurement Manager
NileSoft Solutions

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mohamed El-Sayed <mohamed.elsayed@nilesoft.eg>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-09-12T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for nonresident vendor / PO setup

Hi Mohamed — great to meet yesterday.

Short answer: for most non-US vendors we do not proactively register for local VAT unless requested by legal/finance. That means Redwood will typically accept invoices without Egyptian VAT and rely on the local buyer to self-account under the reverse-charge mechanism, but we need to validate this on a per-case basis with Tax.

What we need from you to complete vendor onboarding and ensure the PO maps correctly:
- Supplier legal name (as on bank account), Egyptian tax/VAT registration number (if available) or a statement that the vendor is non-registered in Egypt
- PDF of the Egyptian VAT certificate (or commercial register) — attach to vendor file
- Sample invoice/proforma showing currency (EGP or USD), unit prices, and a dedicated line indicating tax treatment (e.g., "VAT: reverse-charge — customer liable")
- Bank details (beneficiary name, IBAN/Account, SWIFT) for payment routing

How we map in our ERP (high level): PO header currency -> invoice currency; tax code on invoice line -> determines accounting treatment. If the vendor is nonresident and the buyer is to reverse-charge, we use TAX_CODE: RC_NONRES to create the zero-rated supplier invoice and a corresponding buyer VAT entry. Please have NileSoft indicate the desired tax code on the proforma and we'll align internally.

Cc'ing Laura (ProcureOps) to follow up on the PO field template and required attachments.

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm the exact PO fields we need NileSoft to populate and the preferred upload method for the VAT cert? Mohamed — if you reply with the VAT cert and sample proforma I will route them to our tax team for final sign-off.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Subject: PO template & attachments for Egypt vendor onboarding

Hi Mohamed — Laura from ProcureOps here.

Thanks Ben. Mohamed, below are the concrete fields we need on the PO/invoice to ensure correct posting and to avoid payment delays: 
- PO header: PO number, PO currency (we can accept EGP or USD), PO date
- Supplier fields: Legal name, Supplier ID (we will create this), Supplier VAT or a short note "Non-registered in Egypt"
- Invoice lines: description, qty, unit price, line net amount, TAX_CODE (use "RC_NONRES" if NileSoft expects reverse-charge), tax amount (can be 0), invoice total
- Invoice notes: please include the sentence "Tax treatment: Egyptian VAT reverse-charge — customer to self-account" if you expect us (Redwood) to not be charging VAT

Preferred upload: reply to this thread with the certificate/proforma attached OR use the secure supplier portal link (we will issue invite once the supplier ID is created). For PO mapping our AP team needs the Egyptian tax certificate (scanned PDF) and a bank confirmation letter if different from the invoice.

If NileSoft is VAT-registered in Egypt and intends to charge local VAT, please indicate the VAT rate on the proforma and attach the VAT registration document. In that case we will need to evaluate whether Redwood should register locally or accept the VAT charge, which may change payment terms and tax coding.

Karthik, can you confirm whether we need a signed W-8/foreign tax form for US withholding classification (if they will invoice in USD)?

Mohamed — once you send the two attachments we will create the supplier record and share the temporary portal invite so you can upload future invoices directly against the PO.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
ProcureOps — Redwood Inference
